notes.title: DEV LOG #9 \\ UV REWORK, MAP CHANGES, AND MORE
notes.notes:
[p]It's been a pretty crazy last few weeks, But i've still been able to get quite a bit of work done!
I'll just get right into it.[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/b3bfb5c2aa45192532cc2368a1ca61568b561b2d.png"][/img][b]UV REWORK  \[ DONE ][/b][/h3][p][b]Previously,[/b] UV Evidence would spawn at set locations, with some slight variations.

[b]Now[/b], UV can spawn on any wall, floor, (maybe even ceiling) or door within it's reach, While this might sound like it's Too Much, this actually makes UV evidence much more consistent, And in some cases quicker to get. It also makes items like The Tripod more useful.  While testing is mostly complete, I am working on adding more places for the evidence to spawn. (Like Tables, Chairs, Etc.)
There are patterns to where it spawns, But you'll need to learn these yourself![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/b3bfb5c2aa45192532cc2368a1ca61568b561b2d.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]MAP CHANGES[/b][/h3][p]I decided to add a bit more Detail to The House, and The Ghost Ship. (also did a Lighting & texture update to The Diner)

[b]The House[/b], the backstory behind the location is basically "it was a long-abandoned house (How original) and a new family bought it, and were in the process of restoring it when they noticed Paranormal activity." And now, I feel like it more accurately fits that story. With flooring and carpet being replaced, and Walls being replaced. Here's a look! [/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/6a1a1895e99e6ef617c1c477710893d0646a9e77.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/777988eab16538ba89f63a0864ed4a0a58775212.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/d21040fb0c9a05bfda643f5efa55ba964f079f48.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/da4c198414fe27ab61310c739faf048269b92c83.png"][/img][/carousel][p]

[b]The Ghost Ship[/b], With Scripted UV going away, the rest area really needed some more things for the ghost to leave prints on, so... I added some crates, and a few extra surf boards. It also got some new Lights in the indoor sections.[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/0034d04d7f9da802d2102b32a24ccb4c80da1a80.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/1dbf2bc9242e8cb7fa07ce3fcab9d07f54d7b5dc.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/838d5899c6c4f94606a6beaa1e1516bbb39ea04d.png"][/img][/carousel][p]

[b]The Diner[/b], New Ceiling lights, and updated Kitchen textures. No more chrome stoves or counters.
[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/04c4b4a061e5a04d18b02eb28a1078484503cc7f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/885eb9be8631ca8492b17df3f5d8195b847631ee.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/0eddcdb247c2f14e687a600a277986c7b3193ba7.png"][/img][/carousel][p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/b3bfb5c2aa45192532cc2368a1ca61568b561b2d.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]THE CAVE[/b][/h3][p]The cave is coming along very well, pretty much all I need to do is add interactables, and a bit of extra detail.

And I do have a final set of teasers to share, but I wanted to talk about something first,
I've been thinking a lot about how much I want to share about upcoming maps image wise,
And I think I'm going to share minimal details about them from now on, to give y'all a better experience when playing them for the first time.

I'll still be showing some shots just to give y'all an idea of the maps though,
just not "here's every room in the map," here's the ghost rooms," etc.
I'll probably be keeping some bigger set pieces (Like the waterfall) secret too.

Anyway, Here's the final teasers for The Cave.[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/78e7068f69107844ec9843933d8004df2ce9398a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/8e4a0ca0043e683056f930c8815807b64c283fb7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/6136b0bc65c057d861c4e741b4cacbda50752f41.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/bb923675d2429a4b1a5348f4846916b5dd651ecd.png"][/img][/carousel][p] [/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/b3bfb5c2aa45192532cc2368a1ca61568b561b2d.png"][/img][b]MISC[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Audio Settings have been added[/p][/*][*][p]Added in a Main Menu, Menu Theme, and Intro 'Video'
Also added an ability to Disable the Intro video, and even disable the Main Menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Door feel, and physics. Also improved the ghost's interaction with it.[/p][/*][*][p]Models and textures have been further optimized, And improved in quality.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/b3bfb5c2aa45192532cc2368a1ca61568b561b2d.png"][/img][/p][h3][b][strike]10[/strike] 8 STEPS BEFORE RELEASE[/b][/h3][olist][*][p]Player Controller rework  \[ DONE ][/p][/*][*][p]Book Rework  \[ DONE ][/p][/*][*][p]EMF Rework  \[ DONE ][/p][/*][*][p]UV Rework  \[ DONE ][/p][/*][*][p]Stress System rework  \[ DONE ][/p][/*][*][p]2 New Maps: The School, The Cave  \[ 45% ][/p][/*][*][p]Hunt System  \[ 20% ]  & Ghost Models  \[ Model 1 of 4 Complete ][/p][/*][*][p]Steam Page overhaul & Trailer[/p][/*][*][p]Arcade Games  \[ POST RELEASE ][/p][/*][*][p]Photo System  \[ POST RELEASE ][/p][/*][/olist][p][b]As you can see, I did decide to push back the Arcade Games and Photo System until post-release. These will likely be in the first major update though![/b][b]
(By post release, I mean Early Access, Not V1.0!)

 [/b]
No promises yet, but I'm still aiming for a late August release,
But as I mentioned before, I won't release it until I'm 100% happy with the state it's in.

Anyway, that's all for now! Dev Log 10 will be the Final dev log before release![/p]

notes.title: DEV LOG 8 \\ NEW MAP, ITEM, UI, AND MORE
notes.notes:
[p]Hey! First off, if you saw my last update, you may have seen I've been going through some medical issues.. after like...7 hospital visits, and about a month and a half of being stuck in my room, I've finally fully recovered (For now, at least, lol) and progress on the game has been going pretty well!
I've been working on one of the new maps, The Cave. It's another Large Map, Has 3 Ghost Rooms, and unlocks at Level 7.

[b]And... I'm happy to announce, 4 out of 10 of the steps to release are complete.
[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]But before I get into that, There has been a pretty big increase in scope, Here's what has changed.[/b]
9 Planned Equipment Items [b]>[/b] 21 Planned Equipment Items.
10 - 12 planned maps [b]>[/b] 15 Planned Maps.  You might've noticed, I removed the 'Campaign' stuff from the game page, just for clarification, It is not removed from the game, and will still be available at the V1.0 launch. Anything that isn't in the game was removed from the page to help prevent any confusion.   
[/p][p][/p][p][b]Play Time:[/b] Currently, if you take 10 minutes on average to play through a round, I estimate it'll take you around 6 - 8 Hours (35 Rounds) to get absolutely everything that's currently in the game, Probably closer to 12 - 16 (70 Rounds) after all the unlockable equipment is added in.

With the amount, and quality of the content in the game, I am considering raising the price a bit, But I will let y'all know closer to release.[/p][p]
[b]And... Finally, onto the new stuff![/b]

[/p][h3][b]THE CAVE[/b][/h3][p]3 Ghost Rooms: The Visitors Center, Cave Side A, Cave Side B.
Inspired from actual cave tours I've taken over the last few months.

Here's some W.I.P Images!
[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/7696f7c0bc673087efe128305b6ac48dc883a5fd.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/44ffd5d0bbdcc757532b3792006e38c70425c06c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/40f23808b58f1cbc997ac1f728eae3c0087d1639.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/b58066dde2f88b5fc2754c042dca707f4cbc06e3.png"][/img][/carousel][h3]
[b]PLAYER CONTROLLER[/b][/h3][p]The player controller remake is complete![/p][olist][*][p]Player model rework, new textures, new mesh, and a better rig.[/p][/*][*][p]All new animations, items no longer just flash into existence, and the player's Hand will move out of frame before switching items. (I'm thinking about adding a Toggle to disable the animations if you prefer it to be Instant)[/p][/*][*][p]Better equipment Models, Textures, Size, and Placement, For example, the parabolic cone is smaller, the Spirit Box is more accurately sized, and textures have more... well... Texture to them now as well, The EMF now looks slightly dirty, and the Parabolic textures are no longer stretched out & misplaced.[/p][/*][*][p]New Sounds. Footsteps, EMF, Thermometer, and the Flashlight now have new and/or improved sounds.[/p][/*][*][p]The Parabolic Microphone now realistically lowers audio outside of it's radius.[/p][/*][*][p]The camera is now 5X it's previous resolution, and performs better as well.
FPS settings for the camera have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Code Optimization, Stutters when switching equipment have been fixed, and all unnecessary code was removed. A lot of the code was re-done for better performance as well.[/p][/*][/olist][h3]

[b]THE GHOST BOOK[/b][/h3][p]The Ghost Book has been revamped, new navigation, improved UI, and a Help Menu!
Here's a look at the new UI!
(Also...There is a visual bug on the Investigation menu, this'll be fixed before release)[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/b6b58d734f512427150146f3003d924dba17dfec.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/8ead547d1390a249a06d8e1e738096ff5e84b362.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/6f47c8817d104544767de31018574438b5f2949b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/d30662d9a0194fec49319547c8cd2f22e1186df6.png"][/img][/carousel][p]You may have noticed, The tablet, and all other screens have texturing now, Fingerprints, Smudges, etc. They have a proper Reflective, and glare look to them now as well. (As you probably noticed, there are a few spelling issues in the Help menu, these will be fixed soon.) [/p][p][/p][h3][b]THE MAIN SCREEN[/b][/h3][p]The Main Screen is now a lot more useful than it was in the Alpha,
it's now where you'll Unlock, and upgrade equipment, as well as start investigations.
Here's a look at it.[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/3fbb1d6f2668adc5db204e62979ece5fd58b0f0d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/c00fd05d88d4e351a2d35d495704ec6f2f7039dc.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/a9e6db6fd3dda241f6e22e1ed9635a224c757a05.png"][/img][/carousel][p](You might notice something new as an Unlockable Item... LVP Cost needs to be increased, however... lol)[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]PAUSE MENU[/b][/h3][p]The pause menu has also gotten a Facelift, And a few new Options! I've added in V-Sync, FPS Limit, Field of View, and Mouse Smoothing settings. And... you guessed it, Here's a look![/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/498eebaee0e33f6868e7f950c09ae1a5449e4d8c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/494941e49cc71947fdd6afa61f16877085c78170.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]EVIDENCE CHANGES[/b][/h3][p]I've reworked how the EMF Evidence works, Instead of EMF 2 or 5, ghosts will now give EMF 4 or 5.
And... This also gives me the excuse to not make all obtained EMF Evidence. It's planned for EMF 2 & 3 to be obtainable as Non-Evidence when I get time to!
This is the 'EMF Rework' listed on the 10 steps before release.
And... no, I don't have any images to show off[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]WHAT ELSE?[/b][/h3][p]The book remakes are done as well (the books you can find in the House map) Here's one of 6
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/02fa310f46c6d3ed84a26e17465dc161b7603f35.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]STRESS SYSTEM REWORK[/b]
[u][b]Previously[/b][/u], each time you went in or out of a room, the game would check if the Light was on or off every few seconds. If it was off, it would increase the stress level.

The main issue, if you just went sprinting through a map, you'd trigger a ton of checks at the same time, leading to lag / stutters.

[u][b]Now[/b][/u], at the start of a round, it adds all the Lights in the map into an array, and checks if the closest one within range is on, if so, it lowers stress, if not, it increases stress.

The new system is much less intensive, and can much more accurately increase/decrease stress...and it also works on the Ghost. so the game can now detect if the Player, and the ghost are in the dark[/p][p][/p][p][b]And the UV Rework is nearly there too[/b], The hard part is done at least, but now it's the very...very tedious part...This'll probably be one of the last things I fully complete lol[/p][p][/p][p][b]The tutorial got some changes too[/b], mostly just rewrote some parts to fit with the current direction of the game. The Tutorial was also renamed to Training.
I'm trying to phase out immersion breaking terms & text to make the game a bit more immersive.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Finally, here's the updated Task List[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Player Controller rework  \[ DONE ][/p][/*][*][p]Book Rework  \[ DONE ][/p][/*][*][p]EMF Rework  \[ DONE ][/p][/*][*][p]UV Rework  \[ 70% ][/p][/*][*][p]Stress System rework  \[ DONE ][/p][/*][*][p]Photo System  \[ IN CONCEPT ][/p][/*][*][p]Hunt System  \[ IN CONCEPT ]  & (Custom) Ghost Models  \[ Model 1 of 4 Complete ][/p][/*][*][p]2 New Maps: The School, The Cave  \[ 30% ][/p][/*][*][p]Steam Page overhaul[/p][/*][*][p]Arcade Games (Maybe post-launch, depending on time)[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h3][b]CLOSING[/b][/h3][p]Overall, I'm pretty happy with how it's progressing, It's going quite a bit faster than expected,
And I'm pretty happy with the Quality of everything.

I want to add I'm actually going back to work for a bit to help out, Mostly just weekends, But progress may slow for the next couple weeks while I'm getting settled back in.
[/p][p]And... That's all for this dev log! Thanks for reading.[/p]

notes.title: DEV LOG 7 // UI, Lighting, Player Controller, 10 steps before launch
notes.notes:
[p]Hey! As a side note, Except for the House Lighting, all of these changes were made This Week.
This was actually my first week going full-time into PHANTOM!
And it's actually been progressing much faster than I expected, I am currently going through a few medical issues, so this'll be a fairly brief dev log. (Just wanted to get the dev log out there)[/p][p][/p][h3][b]PLAYER CONTROLLER[/b][/h3][p]I've redone the player model, remade all the Animations, improved the equipment models, and added a few new items... But, I'll go more into this next time.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]UI IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h3][p]The Equipment, Upgrades, and Start Investigation menus have been moved to the Main Screen in the Safe House

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/50b7ecf7e84a2158d71d950d03099e640dfaa7b8.png"][/img]  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]LIGHTING IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h3][p]The lighting in all maps have been improved to look better without Global Illumination enabled, and be more performant. No more dark ceilings, or weird corners. Here's some before and after photos!
[/p][p]Left is old, Right is new.[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/8a35b36599a85f11cb0bfdbedf930aca427289f5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/2127167cb7ff00e5598a64c26b5d024ec5e0156e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/f09522b487e4e2d655e800d4537689a55087cff8.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/4ce8feb5bf9e2ab32fe26b96197fde66ba7ce153.png"][/img][/carousel][p]Keep in mind, the above shots were taken from a wider FOV camera, and a much different angle than intended from the Player.[/p][h3]
[b]SAFE HOUSE[/b][/h3][p]The safe house got a bit of a Makeover! Tiled floors, and more detail.[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/d008c751f62583a17d79e271756da16ca0194142.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/dac76b6d75f797bab565d28a28ae452d51e5645d.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h3][b]CLOSING[/b][/h3][p]For the first week in full-time, I'm pretty happy with the progress made!
Once I'm past the medical issues, I expect progress to move along steadily.
I currently have a 10 step list of things to complete before it's ready to release,
Here's the list, I'll make sure to show the updated list next Dev Log.

You may notice some things are labelled as potentially Post-Launch,
I wrote these in order that they need to be completed, 'Potentially Post Launch' just means they aren't as important to me, and may be pushed back, or in some cases not implemented at all. (Continued below the list)[/p][olist][*][p]Player Controller rework (90% done)[/p][/*][*][p]Book Rework (remaking the books in The House, 30% done)[/p][/*][*][p]EMF Rework (I may wait until post-launch to implement)[/p][/*][*][p]UV Rework (50% done)[/p][/*][*][p]Stress System rework[/p][/*][*][p]Photo System (potentially post-launch, or may not add. Currently in Concept)[/p][/*][*][p]Hunt System & (Custom) Ghost Models[/p][/*][*][p]2 New Maps: The School, The Cave[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Page overhaul[/p][/*][*][p]Arcade Games (Maybe post-launch, depending on time)[/p][/*][/olist][p]The EMF rework is more for making sure some ghost abilities don't cause the EMF readings to bug out,
I will be testing those abilities to see how the system reacts, and to see which system is more performant.

The photo system is just something I made a concept of, and I'll have to see how I can make it feel rewarding to use. Lot's of testing will need to be done to make sure it can't be exploited. (But...I don't care too much about exploits, But making it feel like a rewarding side activity rather than a requirement is important to me)


[/p][p]Anyway, That's all for now! Thanks for reading![/p]

notes.title: What's in the Works for PHANTOM // The final steps until Release
notes.notes:
[p]So, if you've been following the game for awhile you probably know development on PHANTOM is paused while I finish up my Free Game, Aftermath. As I wanted to get it out of the way before I started offering PHANTOM as a paid product.

And I'm happy to say I'm working on the Very Last gameplay section for the free game, After that, 100% of my dev time will be on PHANTOM!

Here's what's left before phantom is ready for Early Access, In Order.

[b]1: Player Controller rework[/b]
    New Player model, Animations, future-proofing, and QoL[/p][p][b]
2: Finishing the UV Rework
     [/b]The current UV system is Distance Based, but the new system I'm implementing is Light Based,
     Meaning, the Color, and intensity of the light is what shows Handprints, Footprints, etc.
[/p][p][b]3: UI Rework[/b]
    For the 'Safe House' I'm wanting to put less emphasis on the Ghost Tab.
    Map Selection, and Upgrades will be moved to the Main Monitor,
    As well as a better Results/End screen. 

[b]4: 2 new maps[/b]
    I've already concepted the last 2 maps needed for early access,
    But...I do have ideas for 2 Bonus maps I could include at Launch, But...Just expect the main 2. 
[/p][p][b]5: Marketing
[/b]    Trailer, and social media posts.

MISC: Game Page rework, discord Rework 


[b]For the Total Content available at Launch:[/b]
15 Upgrades, 5 Maps, 6 Main Items, 3 Unlockable Items

I'm aiming for a July/August release, But I won't release it until I'm 100% happy with it.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Anyway, I think that's all for now. I'm working on a new Dev Log that'll be going up in the next few weeks, after I finish up the Free game.[/p][p]
Thanks for reading![/p][p][/p][p]
If you haven't already, [url="https://gamejolt.com/games/SPECTER/935978"]there's an Alpha build you can try out if you'd like.[/url]
[/p][p]If you have any other questions, Feel free to comment here, or [url="https://discord.gg/tmSpkckqGH"]check out the discord server[/url][/p]

notes.title: DEV LOG #6 \\ WEATHER SYSTEM, LIGHTING UPDATE, PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENTS
notes.notes:
[u][h2]WEATHER SYSTEM & LIGHTING UPDATE:[/h2][/u]
I've added in a weather system, Rain, Snow, Fog, ETC
The weather is randomized at the start of each round, and can change during it.
I.E: You can go from Clear to Rainy, and maybe even to Snowy from there.

As well as this weather system, I've also improved the lighting in each map.

Here's a couple photos of what the new system looks like:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/b8570f691794c88fce64406499c32245a418380e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/225de8ecea1aa31f5b418e83e481ef75d4cdc299.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/d7c8698c22905f0a32512a0b84aef2e5c6eded17.png[/img]

[u][h2]PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENTS:[/h2][/u]
The polycount has been reduced by ~50K per location.
Textures have all been optimized as well, going from 4K to 1K & 2K without a noticeable difference.
I've also improved the FSR Implementation, and added in DLSS.


All of these changes, and Many More are available for y'all to play in a Public Alpha!
If you'd like, you can [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/SPECTER/935978]check it out here[/url]

notes.title: SPECTER Alpha, Today (March 1st 11:00AM CST on Gamejolt!)
notes.notes:
Specter's Alpha is releasing at 11AM CST!
3 Maps, 20 Ghosts, 1 Unlock-able Item 3+ Hours to unlock everything.

This is an Early alpha, with many of the Features not included,
mainly releasing this as a way to get feedback on the game, and to finally give y'all a playable build.
There's also a Feedback form, and bug report form that you can access in-game

Here's what to expect when it launches into early access:
[list]
[*] TWO MORE MAPS.
[*] HUNTS & IMPROVED STRESS SYSTEM.
[*] ANOTHER IN-LOCATION UNLOCK-ABLE ITEM.
[*] FLASHLIGHT WILL BE A INVENTORY ITEM INSTEAD OF AN ITEM YOU ALWAYS HAVE.
[*] SMART WATCH WILL BE A PURCHASABLE ITEM.
[*] PHOTO SYSTEM: TO TAKE PHOTOS OF WALL WRITING, ITEMS, AND SIDE EVIDENCE FOR EXTRA EXPERIENCE.
[*] VOICE RECOGNITION: A WAY TO SPEAK THROUGH THE SPIRIT BOX, AND OTHER ITEMS.
[*] WRITING BOOK: A MORE CLEAR WAY TO GET THE GHOST'S AGE, CAUSE OF DEATH, AND AGGRESSION.
[*] A 'PICK YOUR LOADOUT' MENU: I PLAN ON HAVING 15 - 20 TOTAL ITEMS IN THE GAME, SOME OF WHICH (LIKE THE WRITING BOOK) ARE ABLE TO GET EVIDENCE IN DIFFERENT WAYS, OBVIOUSLY, THIS IS A LOT FOR ONE PLAYER, SO I PLAN ON MAKING A MENU WHERE YOU PICK 1 ITEM YOU WANT TO TAKE WITH YOU FROM DIFFERENT CATEGORIES, I.E: EMF, VIDEO, LIGHTING, ETC)
[/list]

Known Issues:
• You cannot leave without guessing a Ghost. A Patch will likely come out later today to fix it.

[url=https://gamejolt.com/games/SPECTER/935978]You can download it here at 11AM CST[/url]

notes.title: SPECTER Alpha Build - March 1st + Dev Log #5 & More!
notes.notes:
Working on polishing up a build for y'all to try out,

Just wanting to get feedback on Ghosts, Evidence, And how boring, or interesting y'all find the game.

[u][h2]Why am I releasing this Now, instead of a Demo or just straight to early access?[/h2][/u]
This isn't intended to be a form of early access, a Demo, or anything similar.
And I don't feel there's enough maps for me to comfortably release it into early access.

[b]It is just a Alpha, [/b]Released for me to get feedback, criticism, or things you like, or dislike about the game.

Things may change significantly from the Alpha, to early access. I suspect hunts will shake things up quite a bit.

[u][b]What's available in the Alpha?[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] 3 Maps: The House, Diner, and Ghost Ship
[*] 8 Items: EMF, Parabolic Microphone, Spirit Box, Thermometer, Camera, Flashlight & UV Multitool, Smart Watch, and a Unlockable item that needs to be found during your investigation.
[*] Upgrade & Leveling system (14 upgrades total)
[*] Death Investigation
[*] 20 Ghosts, 10 Abilities
[/list]

Where can you get the Alpha?
[url=https://gamejolt.com/games/SPECTER/935978]You can get it over on Game jolt, March 1st.[/url]

[u][b]Important Notes:[/b][/u]
[b]Q:[/b] Is what's in the Alpha complete?
[b]A:[/b] Mostly, There are a few issues with the diner map, Mainly lack of interactions in the Bathrooms. The house & Ghost Ship should be relatively bug free though. But, with it just being an Alpha, expect some bugs & inconsistencies, These will be fixed before Early Access.
But if you encounter any, please report them.

[u][b]
What is SPECTER, Exactly?[/b][/u]

Now, If you've followed SPECTER for awhile, you may know the game has gone through A LOT of changes, from being a Ghost Hunting Parody Game, to a Murder Investigation game, to what it is now.

[b]The game does not, and never will contain Flashy, over the top events, or Jump-scares[/b]
[b]I did recently decide to add manifestations in, But i'm working on ways to make these feel as unscripted as possible.[/b]

Every abnormal event is caused because of, and by: the ghost.
And it will never contain events caused by the player walking over a trigger box.

There are currently 10 ghosts with completely unique Interactions & Events.
I plan on adding onto these until the player can Learn each ghost, and Identify them based on how they interact with The Player, and the environment.

This game started development because I felt like ghost hunting games were becoming increasingly more flashy, and less about the ghosts.
I felt the genre was losing what made me, and likely many others interested in it in the first place,
[b]The Ghosts[/b]
SPECTER isn't intended to one-up, or be "Better than That game," or "Scarier than this game,"
There are many other Amazing ghost hunting games that Have, and always will do Ghost Hunting better than SPECTER.


[u][b]DEV LOG #5[/b][/u]
To keep this brief, here's what's new since the last update!
[list]
[*] 2 new Items: Smart Watch and a Unlockable in-level item.
[*] Reworked Leveling system, the first level only requires 100 XP, and the requirement raises each level until it hits a max of 400, This was aadded to help balance the Death Investigation, and give you some early Level Points, you Also  get some detailed info on what you got XP for.
[*] Finished Evidence & interactions on The Diner, ~180 interactions, 6 Ghost Rooms.
[*] Reworked the Thermometer.
[*] Finished the TV Rework.
[*] Implemented all 14 Upgrades & Balanced them (More in the future!)
[*] Several updates to backend systems (EMF, Parabolic, UV, ETC)
[/list]


I look forward to sharing what I've been working on for nearly 2 Years with you.
Thank you for reading.

- Hollow

notes.title: DEV LOG #1 // FEATURES, UI, GHOST, MAPS, EVIDENCE, GHOST BOOK AND MORE
notes.notes:
This is going to be a fairly lengthy Development Update. A lot of time has passed since the last one, and I'm now working on SPECTER Full-Time. I'm happy to say that development is coming along really well!
I've mostly finished modeling all the diner rooms. added over 110 Interactions to the Diner, Implemented All 20 Ghosts,
Remade Many Player interactions, From Light Switches, To how the equipment Equips & Animates. And Much... Much more.
There's too much to post here, and to be honest, i doubt anyone wants to read about Hit box changes, Footstep sounds, Or how the ghost spawns EMF and Parabolic Evidence..So i'll leave that out lol

Now, You may notice all the other Dev Logs, Map Reveals, ETC, have all been removed.
The game has changed significantly since those older posts, Even the most recent ones.
They've all been removed to prevent confusing new people finding the game, And will be updated over the next few months.
Now, onto the dev update!

Let's start off with
[h2]General Changes[/h2]
Awhile ago, i announced the game would be free, due to recent investments (For the game itself)
changes in Scope, and Other things you'll see later in the post..
I've decided to go back on this, BUT, The game will be free for a week upon launching into early access, It will still be priced around the same as i originally planned ($3 - $6 USD)
And i'm planning a Free Multiplayer Specter game later down the line as well.



[h2]The Gameplay[/h2]
The game, And all 20 Ghost Types, are fully Playable, Functional, And finalized!

The House map is Fully Playable, and as of now, Finalized.

Evidence has been shortened by quite a lot, But more on this later



[h2]The Lighting[/h2]
The new default lighting is a bit of a downgrade, Mainly as it doesn't illuminate Ceilings, and corners as well, But, it gave a 50FPS Increase; you can enable the Old Lighting in the settings menu.
Here's a preview of what the new Default Lighting looks like:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/acbc8386304f5b80575bb8ceaddd13905174bd90.png[/img]



[h2]Player Interactions[/h2]

[b]Lights & Light Switches[/b]
[b]The old system was..really dumb, The camera would do a line trace > Hit an Invisible Box over a Light Switch > When Interacted > The Invisible Box would call an event to a separate Actor > Seperate Actor would Turn on/off lights[/b]

Yeah..This lagged the game pretty badly, But now:

[b]The camera does a line trace > Hits light switch > When Interacted > Toggles lights in Array.[/b]

Much simpler, No Lag at all. Switches are now Animated, and are fully modular with little effort, From sounds, to Custom animations, And more.



[h2]Ghost Tab[/h2]
The ghost tab has been remastered, Finalized.
The ghost tab is no longer a UI Element, and displays on the Tablet Itself.

[b]Page 1:[/b]
Evidence, And Ghost selection
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/ebab58f41d131260f243b267d06790474cf51d2d.png[/img]
When you hover over a Ghost Type, it's Evidence, and any Notes you've saved for that type will appear as well!
This is also where you'll select your ghost
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/86dcec14834599e2ad1454d7b8be721a8feed713.png[/img]

[b]Page 2:[/b]
Ghost Tab, Where you can write down all the Side Evidence and Traits you've noticed.
Example: "Hot Temps, Gibberish Writing, Smoke-Filled Room, Interacted a lot, But did not leave it's Room,"
(W.I.P - No image just yet!)

[b]Page 3:[/b]
Potential Ghost name, Location Name, Potential Ghost Rooms, Cause of concern, and a Map of the location
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/80b3ab76b633126ae69df8ceb94cdcab67afcb93.png[/img]
(For anyone Curious, at the start of a round, the ghost will pick a Random First and Last name, There's around 110 First Names, And 100 Last names, I do plan on Adding More in the future though!)


[h2]Ghosts[/h2]
Before adding all of the ghosts in, i decided to expand the Traits a bit, Here's the current list (leaving these intentionally vague..)
[olist]
[*] Throw Distance/Speed
[*] Aggressiveness
[*] Height (Not Visible to the Player)
[*] Height (Visible to the Player)
[*] Scared of the Dark?
[*] Speed
[*] Interaction Chance
[*] Interaction MIN (Affects the Interaction Chance variable, The Lower the 'Interaction Variable, the more likely the Interaction)
[*] Interaction MAX (Some calmer ghosts will have a Higher MAX, Meaning less interactions)
[*] Interaction Speed
[*] Unique Interaction Chance (Power outages, Creepy Music, Stuff like that)
[*] Roam Chance
[*] Roam Timer
[/olist]
These will all be unique for each ghost, More may be added in the future.

[b]Side note for Interaction & Evidence,
Each time a ghosts does an interaction, or gives evidence,
That Variable Increases, Each time it Doesn't, That variable decreases,  Once it gets too low or too high, it'll change to the MIN or MAX Variable. The rate that it increases/Decreases depends on the Ghost Type, and it's Aggressiveness Level.[/b]
This gives a more dynamic feel to the ghosts, and makes them feel like they aren't just on a Timer.

There are currently 20 Ghosts in the game, As i've gotten more experienced with UE, There's some other evidence i really want to add...So, i'm not promising anything, but i'd like to see up-to 30 in the game.
But for now, I'm focusing on making each ghost feel unique.


[b]Evidence[/b]
I posted on the Patreon some time ago that the Evidence was going from 6 Categories: EMF, UV, Parabolic, Camera, Temp, Wall Writing
To 3 Main Evidence Categories: EMF, UV, Parabolic.
These will be harder to get than the Side evidence, Which is:
Camera, Temp, and Wall Writing.

Side Evidence is just an Attribute of the ghost, and Easier to obtain.
The Ghost Tab has a Note System for each Ghost, So, If you identify a Ghost, you can stick around and get its Side evidence and add it to your notes for that ghost.

For example, If you've found all the Side Evidence for all ghosts with EMF 5, You can get EMF 5, then finish the investigation using the Side Evidence And Traits Only.

There's no Overlapping Main, or Side Evidence, But i did make ghosts with Mixed EMF Very Similar to other ghosts.


On a side note, EMF Has been shortened from [b]EMF 2, 3, 4, 5, Mix, None[/b] To [b]EMF 2, 5, Mix[/b]
And [b]Laser Pen[/b] has been removed entirely.
These have been changed to improve Gameplay, And prevent you from only needing 2 Evidences.

[b]TL;DC the game is going from 26 Evidence to 11[/b]



[h2]Safe House Update[/h2]
the safe house got a little bit of a Visual Update, new pool table, Re-textured Arcade Machines, and a Slideshow of Screenshots of each map.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/b14fa35f9a6a56adf8ab6132eee7edf7e002efd9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/f21f83d61a5e242985f5a2c1cef0f40d6989e473.png[/img]



[h2]The Ghost Ship Update (W.I.P)[/h2]
The ghost ship previously only had Two rooms, The ship, and the Lounge Area, But it's currently being expanded upon, With Restrooms, and a Rest/Vending Area being Added!
The waves had to be less than Half the quality due to performance reasons, Mainly to play on Lower End Computers, But now, they are at their Highest Quality by Default, and you can change their quality in the Settings Menu, from High Tri (100K), to Low Tri (6K), to Extremely Low Tri (~20, Waves Disabled)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/1811c1959f38bbc376a48c3b03f31691d770cc4d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/66bcdc322e95ebea40ed15b53462094cb17c828b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44243517/f54758145b3f76b392cfe60f5ccd0059eb2a79c0.png[/img]



[h2]Misc[/h2]
Campaign Mode has been renamed to Story Mode

Wall Writing is now only visible on the Camera

The player now has Limited Sprint, and can now Sprint while crouched (Much slower than while standing, though!)


[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
So..While playing the game, it just feels a little..Boring. So..I've started work on Hunts!
If you aren't aware, Hunts were meant to just be for Hard mode, Which was meant to be added in near the full release, But now i'm actively working on it,
2 Ghost Models partially finished, and Stress mechanics figured out, but not implemented.

For those who don't like Hunts, they can be disabled next to the Arcade.
Due to how some maps are designed, they won't be able to support hunts, so they'll be in their own section of the Arcade.

And... At the start of the post, i mentioned i made an investment for the game,
Which is a Full Mocap Setup! Story Mode, Ghosts, and any other animations, will be fully Mocap!

This allows me to spend far less time animating, and more time on actual Gameplay, Maps, and Mechanics.



That's all for now. The game has come along significantly the last few months, And i'm pretty excited for the future of it!
